situations.situation: When writing a weekly work report about review results, the user wants the measured progress and metric meanings reported accurately.

intents.intent_explanation: When a report gives a measured rate, the user wants the counts behind it so the size of the result is clear.
requirements: State the numerator and denominator alongside a reported rate when those counts are available.

intents.intent_explanation: When a report summarizes agreement between reviewers, the user wants its meaning preserved so agreement is not mistaken for correctness.
requirements: Describe reviewer agreement as agreement; claim accuracy only when an independent correctness reference supports it.

situations.situation: When writing up a planning meeting, the user wants each decision recorded with an owner and a due date when one was agreed.

intents.intent_explanation: When meeting notes list decisions, the user wants each decision attributable and time-bound so it can be followed up later.
requirements: Record each decision together with its owner and, when one was agreed, its due date.
